submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent was 1.16e-6 A at Co0.35V0.65 (index 13). Photocurrent went up from the V-rich end (0.7e-6 A at Co 0.13) to Co 0.35, then dropped sharply to 8e-8 A at Co 0.48. That places the peak somewhere between Co 0.13 and 0.48, probably near 0.3–0.4.

rejected.reason: Measured 8e-8 A. Photocurrent falls sharply above Co 0.35.
Not measured. The steep drop at Co 0.48 suggests Co-rich films are poor, but this is inferred from one point.
